policy: Both complete campaigns are independently validated from raw reports; partial or failed sources are rejected.
Input/configuration/shader/output/count equality is exact, excluding only explicitly named initialization time observations.

All recorded aggregate and per-frame read statistics are compared exactly. Per-frame comparison omits only diagnostic latency_ms and retains trajectory/frame order, receiver counts, null/unavailable readings and every other recorded field. Individual per-pixel read histograms are not stored and their equality is not claimed.

The old input audit/independent tests predate redundant raw_valid_mask metadata: it is reconstructed only from their existing pre-border support-mask hash; independent plan hashes are verified before canonicalization. All other input metadata remains exact.

Old instrumented count summaries also predate mismatch_examples and mismatch_example_limit. Only when both fields are absent, correctness explicitly passed, all visibility/root/invalid mismatch counts are zero, and maximum first-root error is zero at the fixed tolerance, their canonical defaults are [] and 32. Every present value is preserved: nonempty examples, changed limits, partial schemas and failures are never normalized away. Original metadata differences remain in documented_count_diagnostics_enrichment.
Measurement source hashes are compared against the old formal-timing snapshots. Earlier independent-source snapshot differences are retained separately, not silently treated as unchanged code.
Warm/cold timestamp observations vary; changes and all repeats are retained, not used as deterministic pass/fail criteria.
Paired ratios and confidence intervals stay attached to their own campaign; no best-run selection, pooling, or paper replacement.
Confidence-interval overlap is not evidence of timing equivalence; flags below one are descriptive within-run checks.
First-trajectory-frame cold values do not measure device/pipeline startup; initialization observations are separate.
Reproducibility and finite independent tests strengthen evidence, but do not guarantee correctness for all inputs or true missing scene geometry.
